_meta.purpose: Vampire persona + passionate/dispassionate axis.  Tone axis modulating emotional intensity in the response.  Vampire is the first base-persona candidate (|μ|=1.75, n=4) -- vampire's centuries of memory invite both ardent passion and weary detachment.  Question mix: 6 broad-topic prompts where the response can be delivered with either fire or remove + 4 dispassionate-style emotion-laden prompts + 1 vampire-role probe + 2 extraction power-questions + 1 hand-written.
